canonical_statement: For every field K, stable matrix-equivalence classes of finite-dimensional central simple K-algebras form an abelian group whose multiplication is induced by tensor product, whose identity is represented by K, and whose inverse is represented by the opposite algebra.
domain_and_universes: universes u v; K : Type u with Field K; CSA.{u,v} K representatives have carrier Type v and bundle centrality, simplicity, and finite-dimensionality
minimal_import_evidence: Removing TensorProduct.Basic fails at tensorRep_equiv because no Semiring instance for the tensor product is available; BrauerGroup.Defs supplies CSA, IsBrauerEquivalent, its setoid, and BrauerGroup.

operation_contract.multiplication: tensorRep A B is algebra-equivalent to TensorProduct K A B and respects IsBrauerEquivalent in both arguments
operation_contract.identity: oneRep is algebra-equivalent to K and its quotient class is 1
operation_contract.inverse: invRep A is algebra-equivalent to MulOpposite A and its quotient class is the group inverse
operation_contract.laws: the same bundled CommGroup instance is linked to all representative equations

alternate_encodings.quotient_equality: BrauerClass A = BrauerClass B iff IsBrauerEquivalent A B is a definitional quotient consequence and is strictly weaker than the root
alternate_encodings.wedderburn_artin: matrix-over-division-algebra normal form is supporting classification, not a transport equivalent to the root
alternate_encodings.morita_equivalence: no checked reverse bridge to IsBrauerEquivalent is credited
